note:
A4 R1: reduced dendrite (cable) toy calibrated on the emodel's own synaptic voltages (understand/out/vsyn_old.csv,
made by measure_v.py from the v_seg prefire records; old emodel delta-split2 s2g0321).
Toy: soma + two dendrite classes c in {basal, apical} (data has no oblique / trunk / tuft label yet: apical = all apical).
  fast (bAP):   bAP_syn(d) / bAP_soma = att_c(d) = f_c + (1 - f_c) exp(-d / lam_fast_c)               (1st pairing)
                5th pairing: bAP5_syn / bAP5_soma = att_c(d) * exp(-kap_c * (f / 50 Hz) * d / 100 um)    (use-dependent loss)
  slow (DC):    sealed-end cable spread of a somatic slow depolarisation, V_syn / V_soma = g_c(d) =
                cosh((ell_c - d) / lam_slow_c) / cosh(ell_c / lam_slow_c)
FITTED (7): lam_fast_c, f_c, kap_c (bAP1 + bAP5 ratios, all paired protocols except the step, both pathways) and
  lam_slow_c (Sjostrom 2007 200 ms paired step: interspike plateau vstep_lo at synapse / soma).
ANCHORED: soma values per (pair, protocol) = the same simulation's somatic V (syn_id -1 rows); ell_basal = 99th pct of
  basal synapse path distances in the table; ell_apical = median apical max path length of the post cells
  (plastyfire/ebner/pair_geometry_L23PC_L5TTPC.csv post_apical_max).
VALIDATION (not fitted): residual depolarisation before the 5th pairing at each synapse predicted as vres5_soma * g_c(d);
  excess = data - prediction = local (synaptic / dendritic) part that does not come from the soma.
Reference line only: Sjostrom 2001 Fig 5D somatic residual depolarisation 0 / 4.9 / 8.3 / 12.0 mV at 10/20/40/50 Hz.
Out: figs/A4_R1_attenuation.png + figs/A4_R1_attenuation_data.json (params, fit stats, every plotted number, sources).
  python cable_toy.py [--csv CSV]

sources.sjostrom2001_soma: Sjostrom, Turrigiano & Nelson 2001 Neuron, Fig 5D (somatic residual depolarisation)
